timing: Specified after reading the previous DCE results, identifying prior possession of 107 positive uncapped endpoints and reading related exponential-family literature. Specified before calculating endpoint tangential fits, fitting paths or examining their price and Bere outcomes. Exploratory secondary analysis.
question: How much does an existing finite-estimation boundary change preference trade-offs, price signs and held-out loss as an analyst moves weight toward it? Is a boundary associated with a specific vanishing menu probability that explains the change?
source: Pinned released COSCBB workbook, same respondent training/evaluation split, frozen predictor and all 500 nested allocations at each retained budget as the previous DCE audit.
inputs: Previously verified power_frontier_20261118 report and its nested inputs, existing public_panel_dce baseline records. Keep the original coding and signed three-term loss.
denominator: All 107 stored positive uncapped endpoints among 2000 allocation-by-budget cases; 87 at five people and 20 at ten. Preserve the 58 zero/near-zero and 1835 capped cases in inventory. In the low budgets use all 835 capped cases as controls with saved finite unit-power estimates, evaluated at the same eight points below one. Compare within allocations over powers. None of these repeated allocations is a new person or independent cohort.
path: Distances as fractions of stored positive upper endpoint: 0.5, 0.1, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001, 0.00001, 0.000001, 0.0000001. For capped controls use endpoint exactly one. Retain every case at every point and the unrounded coefficient vector, original objective score, curvature check and held-out log loss. Evaluate no data-dependent selected weight.
facets: Use the saved dual direction to identify menu ties at 1e-8 absolute normalized utility, optionally reconstruct an exact primitive integer normal from the rational within-menu differences when their rank is p-1. Check full design contrast rank, exact tied comparisons, transverse slack slope, agreement with original-row frontier, and a positive conditional-support margin (>1e-8 up to numerical resolution) on the tied alternatives at the endpoint. When rank or interiority does not qualify, report the state separately and keep its finite fits and economics.
target_choices: Primary economic outcomes are sign of cost coefficient and the Bere price equivalent GBP -10 beta_bere/beta_cost on each negative-cost fit. Report positive and numerical-zero costs explicitly (zero tolerance 1e-9). Keep every signed nonzero algebraic ratio, without trimming. Count the predicted-preference decision at a GBP 2.50 premium, an adjacent experimental price step, on negative-price fits and tabulate changes between c/2 and each final path and same-allocation labelled ridge and cost-accounted human MNL controls. Repeat descriptive counts at GBP 0 and GBP 5.00 for sensitivity and retain cases where classifications are undefined.
geometry: At a transverse facet verify the normal slack identity, tangential face-limit estimate, predicted logarithmic escape with coefficient set by the smallest positive within-menu gap, leading constant from tied-menu fits, and held-out log-loss slope from the evaluation chosen alternatives. Keep signed directions, exact zero price components, fit discrepancies and failures. The price-equivalent implications are conditional on the relevant denominator and direction. No WTP population inference or CI.
comparison_scope: Compare negative-price percentages, median and 5th–95th percentiles with unchanged paired denominators. Retain old and new directional/risk claims as finite fixed-design mechanisms. Cap controls differ in support; comparisons across groups are descriptive and do not identify a causal effect of weights, participants or sample size.
validation: Independently recompute original-row three-term score, held-out log loss and source price decisions for each fit. Verify all actual facets against exact contrast rank and an independently reconstructed original-menu tangent condition. Compare raw independent LP endpoints for all 107 uncapped cases. Re-run from an unpacked release and check full output inventory.
